label: 12-channel desktop NVR, 2 bays
description: 12-channel desktop network video recorder with two drive bays, one gigabit RJ45 port and no PoE. Cameras are licensed per channel and must be powered separately.
notes: No PoE out and only one 1GbE port, so camera traffic shares the uplink with management. Wired only. Surveillance Station camera licences are per-channel - a lab that assumes 12 free channels is wrong out of the box.
